description: Sharp graphic editorial portrait — premium fashion-magazine grade, hard graphic composition. Classic studio or golden-hour outdoor. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot and the aspect_ratio to make it at — pair it with generate_image and pass that aspect_ratio along.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional frame shape. Replaces the shape the style uses by default. The answer carries aspect_ratio: pass it to generate_image so the picture is made at that shape.

style.description: classic = Hasselblad H6D studio. golden_hour = Canon R5 outdoor.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_graphic_editorial_portrait
title: Apply Graphic Editorial Portrait
